references.text: The regulations for the grain offering and drink offering that were to accompany the burnt offering are described in detail here, with the amounts of flour, oil, and wine to be used for bulls, rams, and lambs.
The drink offering belonging to the Sabbath burnt offering follows the same pattern with prescribed amounts.
Earlier in the same chapter, grain offerings and drink offerings for the Feast of Tabernacles are described, with the fixed amounts 'according to the regulation'.
Identical wording is used for the grain offering and drink offering on the second day of the Feast of Tabernacles, 'by number, as prescribed'.
The same pattern is repeated for the third day of the Feast of Tabernacles with grain offerings and drink offerings 'according to the regulation'.
Summary of the Lord's feasts which include burnt offerings, grain offerings, peace offerings, and drink offerings, each on its proper day.
